item: Should I buy the Panacean Star-Up Crystal for 20,000 Diamonds (VIP shop)?
detail: 20,000 Diamonds is about 66 pulls, or about 3 weeks of a free player's Diamonds (about 6,350 a week). You can get Panaceans for free instead. The Real-Time Arena shop sells one Panacean and a weekly pack of 15 Panacean shards for PvP coins. The game's shop table lists both items. Aslan says to skip it in two separate videos (October 25 and November 3, 2026). Buy it only if one Panacean finishes a star that unlocks a key passive on your main team, and you have already saved enough Diamonds for the next banner.
source: Game data (ShopRealPvp_Item_8 Panacean Star-Up Crystal, ShopRealPvp_Item_11 Panacean shard x15, ShopVip_Item_7); creator videos Aslan, October 25 and November 3, 2026

item: Should I buy the 2 golden coins at VIP 10 for 20,000 Diamonds each?
detail: Golden coins are universal copies used to star up gold units. One costs the same as about 66 pulls. Worth it only when that coin finishes a 1★ passive that changes your team. Examples: Hinami [Halloween]'s +50% ATK and HP, Juzo [False Girl]'s +16% to all allies, Toka [Maid]'s +30%. If the coin is just for more stats, save the Diamonds for Carnival pulls. Shi says Carnival pulls also give Panaceans and gold coins. The exact price and weekly limit for the VIP 10 slot are not in the public data.
